TITLE: Psy Liquid Opal Flow
DESCRIPTION: 4-octave curl-advected 3D fluid heightfield with central-difference surface normals, thin-film spectral interference, and procedural studio-chrome reflections. Delivers hyper-glossy liquid mercury waves gleaming with deep indigo, electric cyan, molten gold, and magenta opal oil-slicks. Tweak speed (flow velocity), intensity (exposure), turbulence (curl warp relief), iridescence (thin-film phase), chrome (mirror sheen), and focus (camera drift).
